data.animaCaption: Tilting her rain-beaded clear umbrella over your shoulder while wearing a frosted translucent raincoat, she reaches out to catch your sleeve with quiet resolve. Cool blue rainlight frames her face as warm shopfront reflections shimmer on the wet pavement behind her.
data.promptProse: Composed from beneath the beaded edge of a shared transparent vinyl umbrella, Ayachi Nene stands close on a glistening rainy street at dusk. She wears a semi-transparent frosted raincoat over a pale pink knit vest, crisp white blouse, and grey pleated skirt; one hand holds the umbrella shaft tilted toward the viewer while her other hand gently clasps the viewer's wrist. Raindrops streak down the curved plastic canopy in the upper foreground, while cool blue evening rain contrasts with soft amber storefront lights reflected in puddles across the wet asphalt behind her.
data.story: 雨点密密麻麻敲打在透明伞面上。宁宁把伞悄悄朝你这边倾斜了一大半，任由磨砂雨衣的肩头被水汽打湿，却认真地牵住你的手腕——「不管以后会遇到什么麻烦，我都不会再一个人逃走了。这次，换我站在你身边。」
